questions.q: In "What biometrics are, and when they are the wrong answer Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Accuracy: false accept and false reject rates, thresholds, why published accuracy may differ from your place, why testing in real conditions matters.
Score: need 2/5, accuracy 4/5, fairness 3/5, privacy risk 2/5 (high risk), cost 3/5; card plus PIN wins on privacy.

questions.q: In "Challenge circle Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Lower the threshold to cut rejects to 0.5% (5 a day) and false accepts rise to 0.8% = 0.4 a day, about 2 in 5 days. The trade-off is clear.
Card plus PIN: cost 5 per card, 300 staff = 1,500, no sensitive data stored, lost-card risk handled by revoking.
